{{Quote|A thief stole my lightsaber, and I only got a quick look at him. I could tell he definitely came from one of the aquatic planets, you know, one of the waterworlds?''"<br />"''So, you're saying there was something ''fishy'' about him?|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]]|<ref name="LL" />}}
'''Patrolia''' was the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]]<ref name="LL" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="JFTFN" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''The Essential Atlas Online Companion'' this planet was initially misspelled "Pitrolea". Author [[Jason Fry]] clarified and linked the species with the planet.<ref name="JFTFN" />
